description_en: Apartment for sale 2+1+2 in Selvia, near the Center. The apartment is located on the 2nd floor in a new building with 2 well-maintained elevators. The apartment is organized by the living room together with the kitchen, a corridor that divides the 2 bedrooms, one with a bathroom, 1 toilet and 1 balcony. The apartment is sold furnished as in the photo, it has a total area of ​​112 m2. With order contracts.
